Definition
[Essential supremum] 1. appE:E.2-def-3\group Measure Theory For a measurable real-valued function $f$, \[ \operatorname *{ess\, sup}f :=\inf \{ \mu \in \mathbb R\mid |\{ f>\mu \} |=0\} . \]
